changelog:
• Faster, cleaner start: the main window opens only when your license, GPU/CPU and services are ready
• New update window with clear progress, and a smoother restart after an update
• Clipro checks your cookies before Download Now / Start Scraping and tells you if a login has expired
• License now shows your plan and expiry date, with a new gold badge for Lifetime licenses
• Download History: generate or regenerate captions (one or many), copy a caption, stop AI captions
• Download Now retries failed videos, and the queue tells you which videos were skipped
• Ctrl+F search in the Activities table, and Export CSV can save each profile separately
• Faster AI caption uploads with GPU acceleration on supported graphics cards
• Downloads resume by themselves after a network drop
• Clearer error messages, and better Facebook and Instagram captions
